facts.note: Transcript gives the temple bell striking nine, the request that everyone show watches, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolding him for it.
Piquet in the salon without a break, the temple striking ten during play, play continuing until the doctor went out for cigars, and her not looking at the clock when he left. All stated.
As he went out he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
'A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.' Same timepiece, same reading, same relation.
